using namespace std;

long long v;
long long cand[17];

int main() {
    scanf("%lld", &v);
    cand[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
        cand[i] = cand[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }

    function<int(int, long long)> rec = [&](int ind, long long val) -> int {
        val = abs(val);
        if (ind == 0) return val;
        long long a1 = val / cand[ind];
        long long a2 = a1 + 1;
        return min(a1 * (ind + 1) + rec(ind - 1, val - a1 * cand[ind]),
                   a2 * (ind + 1) + rec(ind - 1, val - a2 * cand[ind]));
    };

    printf("%d\n", rec(16, v));
    return 0;
}
